pair_supervised_unsupervised_singlehand_.split: split from which data should be read
pair_supervised_unsupervised_singlehand_.mini_dataset: if mini_dataset dict is empty & use_mini_dataset is True
json file in './misc would be received
pair_supervised_unsupervised_singlehand_.add_first_last_frame: supervised fraction could be used to turn off supervisory of some frames
pair_supervised_unsupervised_singlehand_.images_features: images_features are saved extracted features from a pretrained net
pair_supervised_unsupervised_singlehand_.labelset: label_set would be avaliable_annotation in loader
